description: Adds collapsible In-Thread RPG Companion Bar in Campaign Forum threads
replace:
$0
<xf:if is="$rpgThreadCampaign">
	<xf:macro template="cv6_rpg_thread_companion" name="companion_bar"
		arg-campaign="{$rpgThreadCampaign}"
		arg-thread="{$thread}"
		arg-characters="{$rpgThreadCharacters}"
		arg-battlemapLinks="{$rpgThreadBattlemapLinks}"
		arg-handoutLinks="{$rpgThreadHandoutLinks}"
		arg-isGm="{$rpgThreadIsGm}" />
</xf:if>
